Capital efficiency

How does the reserve grow?

Brazilian agencies requirea guarantee on every lease.
When tenants don't pay,
agencies cover it themselves.Other solutions take up to 60 days.
MUTAV backs the agency, on Solana.
19 agencies signed letters of intent.For the hackathon, we built the protocol.
Is every guarantee really backed? First,let's register Ana's guarantee: R$18,000.
On-chain, she's just an ID,no personal data.
The reserve holds BRS, a Brazilianstablecoin from Nora Finance,
and anyone can check
it meets the coveragethe reserve admin sets.
Let's try one more lease.That needs R$45,000; we have R$44,500.
Refused.
We can't promisewhat we can't back.
What happens when Ana pays late?
The agency files a claim,our operator verifies it,
the reserve pays out,within the multisig's limits,
and our PIX to the agencyis recorded on-chain.
Filed to settled, on-chain:65 seconds.
Not 60 days.
And it's all public: every guarantee,claim and account,
live at reserve.mutav.finance.
Today, our team signs each stepfrom our operator console.
Next, a server walletin our platform signs them,
within limitsthe program enforces.
How does the reserve grow? Six monthsof our pilot plan, simulated locally,
growing itto R$1 million.
New capital, guarantee fees and yield come in.Small claims go out.
So the reserve can back more leases.
MUTAV: a reserve you can see,
payments that run themselves,and capital that works.
Brazil's on-chain rent guarantee.
